integrity: The exact fourth-power trace polarization and a sharp scalar radical factorization give a positive two-term angular deficit. Equality is characterized by orthogonal initial and final support spaces and equal chord norms; converse configurations exist in every Hilbert dimension at least two. The checker replays exact symbolic and integer-matrix identities, supplemented by numerical noncommuting tests. No independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is proved for Schatten exponent four over real or complex Hilbert spaces of dimension at least two. It does not claim an exact P-angle law for other Schatten exponents or operator-norm stability of near extremizers.
title: Sharp P-angle and two-sided support rigidity in Schatten-four spaces
